svg.title: Announcing Query Insights For Prisma Postgres
svg.desc: The Queries tab of a Prisma Postgres database as a full width panel: average latency and queries per second, a latency chart, and four grouped query shapes with their execution and read counts, the expensive aggregate highlighted. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand, prism yellow accent.
